title: fruit and vegetable brush
text: fruit and vegetable brush. I purchased this version (you get 2) to replace one with a handle... I am still trying to get used to it.  One part of the brush (the biggest amount of the bristles) are soft the other portion is supposed to be stiffer and the bristles are slightly stiffer, but not a lot.  There is a plastic tip to poke out potato eyes - but I don't do that so not sure it has much value.  I think I miss my old handled veg brush, but maybe because this is a new method.  I am not going to give up them yet.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I like to put my brushes through the dishwasher every so often to make sure they stay as clean as possible and I have NOT tried that yet with these.. we'll see.  The top is a black plastic.  The bristles are gray and black and feel like a plastic of some sort.

product_metadata.title: MR.SIGA Fruit and Vegetable Cleaning Brush with Non Slip Comfortable Grip, Pack of 2, Black
features: COMBINATION OF DUAL ACTION BRISTLES: Features two different nylon bristles: angled gentle grey bristles for mushrooms, delicate produce, while stiff straight white bristles for scrubbing potatoes, radish, cucumbers and more.

THOROUGH CLEANING: MR.SIGA produce brush with durable nylon bristles quickly remove dirt, stain on produce, it's definitely a handy, helpful tool to efficiently get your fruits and vegetables clean which save your precious time. Built-in plastic remover is designed for removing potato eyes.

COMFORTABLE GRIP: MR.SIGA vegetable brush is designed with an ergonomic shape which conforms to contour of your palm, TPR covered non slip surface fits comfortably in your palm, it won't slip out of your grasp even when wet for tough scrubbing.
USE & CARE: Easy to use and dishwasher safe. Simply hold produce under running water while scrubbing for best results. Rinse with water after each use and air dry.

MR.SIGA's mission: Make your housework easier, and make the world cleaner. If you’re not happy about the product, you’re covered by a full refund. Please do not hesitate to contact us with any questions you may have, we are here for support and advice!
